_comment: The communities named on the public site, in display order. Extracted verbatim from the hardcoded list that src/index.njk carried twice (the marquee track and its aria-hidden clone) so the same names could not drift apart between the two, and so the service-page location strip renders the same list rather than a second hand-typed one. Adding a name here publishes a service-area claim on every page that renders the strip, so only add a community the owner has confirmed.
_scopeComment: This is the 'nearby communities' display list and is deliberately separate from src/_data/towns.json, which is the portfolio-project location registry (project tags, JSON-LD contentLocation, sitemap). A town appearing here is NOT a claim that a project was built there, and a town in towns.json is not automatically in the service area.
